column1: # Phase 2: the node harnesses out of the apps/ root, into apps/harness/ (tools/reorg/run_all.sh).
# apps/ keeps the cart SOURCES (zig/, c/, rust/, ports/, tex_loader_fx/) and its README; the
# harnesses, the fixtures they read and their perf/ library move together, so a harness's
# ./sibling.mjs and ./perf/x.mjs imports stay as they are.
# Columns are TAB-separated. Every file directly in apps/ must be classified (the `check` line).
# Harnesses the docs name but the tree does not have (gone, or planned): they belong in harness/ too
# --verify: path joins no table can see (patched by hand in phase2_harness.patch)
